from typing import Any
from urllib.parse import parse_qs, quote_plus, unquote, urlparse

import pandas as pd
import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup

from lfx.custom import Component
from lfx.io import IntInput, MessageTextInput, Output, TabInput
from lfx.schema import DataFrame
from lfx.utils.request_utils import get_user_agent


class WebSearchComponent(Component):
    display_name = "Web Search"
    description = "Search the web, news, or RSS feeds."
    documentation: str = "https://docs.langflow.org/web-search"
    icon = "search"
    name = "UnifiedWebSearch"

    inputs = [
        TabInput(
            name="search_mode",
            display_name="Search Mode",
            options=["Web", "News", "RSS"],
            info="Choose search mode: Web (DuckDuckGo), News (Google News), or RSS (Feed Reader)",
            value="Web",
            real_time_refresh=True,
            tool_mode=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="query",
            display_name="Search Query",
            info="Search keywords for news articles.",
            tool_mode=True,
            required=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="hl",
            display_name="Language (hl)",
            info="Language code, e.g. en-US, fr, de. Default: en-US.",
            tool_mode=False,
            input_types=[],
            required=False,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="gl",
            display_name="Country (gl)",
            info="Country code, e.g. US, FR, DE. Default: US.",
            tool_mode=False,
            input_types=[],
            required=False,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="ceid",
            display_name="Country:Language (ceid)",
            info="e.g. US:en, FR:fr. Default: US:en.",
            tool_mode=False,
            value="US:en",
            input_types=[],
            required=False,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="topic",
            display_name="Topic",
            info="One of: WORLD, NATION, BUSINESS, TECHNOLOGY, ENTERTAINMENT, SCIENCE, SPORTS, HEALTH.",
            tool_mode=False,
            input_types=[],
            required=False,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="location",
            display_name="Location (Geo)",
            info="City, state, or country for location-based news. Leave blank for keyword search.",
            tool_mode=False,
            input_types=[],
            required=False,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        IntInput(
            name="timeout",
            display_name="Timeout",
            info="Timeout for the request in seconds.",
            value=5,
            required=False,
            advanced=True,
        ),
    ]

    outputs = [Output(name="results", display_name="Results", method="perform_search")]

    def __init__(self, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(**kwargs)

    def update_build_config(self, build_config: dict, field_value: Any, field_name: str | None = None) -> dict:
        """Update input visibility based on search mode."""
        if field_name == "search_mode":
            # Show/hide inputs based on search mode
            is_news = field_value == "News"
            is_rss = field_value == "RSS"

            # Update query field info based on mode
            if is_rss:
                build_config["query"]["info"] = "RSS feed URL to parse"
                build_config["query"]["display_name"] = "RSS Feed URL"
            elif is_news:
                build_config["query"]["info"] = "Search keywords for news articles."
                build_config["query"]["display_name"] = "Search Query"
            else:  # Web
                build_config["query"]["info"] = "Keywords to search for"
                build_config["query"]["display_name"] = "Search Query"

            # Keep news-specific fields as advanced (matching original News Search component)
            # They remain advanced=True in all modes, just like in the original component

        return build_config

    def validate_url(self, string: str) -> bool:
        """Validate URL format."""
        url_regex = re.compile(
            r"^(https?:\/\/)?" r"(www\.)?" r"([a-zA-Z0-9.-]+)" r"(\.[a-zA-Z]{2,})?" r"(:\d+)?" r"(\/[^\s]*)?$",
            re.IGNORECASE,
        )
        return bool(url_regex.match(string))

    def ensure_url(self, url: str) -> str:
        """Ensure URL has proper protocol."""
        if not url.startswith(("http://", "https://")):
            url = "https://" + url
        if not self.validate_url(url):
            msg = f"Invalid URL: {url}"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        return url

    def _sanitize_query(self, query: str) -> str:
        """Sanitize search query."""
        return re.sub(r'[<>"\']', "", query.strip())

    def clean_html(self, html_string: str) -> str:
        """Remove HTML tags from text."""
        return BeautifulSoup(html_string, "html.parser").get_text(separator=" ", strip=True)

    def perform_web_search(self) -> DataFrame:
        """Perform DuckDuckGo web search."""
        query = self._sanitize_query(self.query)
        if not query:
            msg = "Empty search query"
            raise ValueError(msg)

        headers = {"User-Agent": get_user_agent()}
        params = {"q": query, "kl": "us-en"}
        url = "https://html.duckduckgo.com/html/"

        try:
            response = requests.get(url, params=params, headers=headers, timeout=self.timeout)
            response.raise_for_status()
        except requests.RequestException as e:
            self.status = f"Failed request: {e!s}"
            return DataFrame(pd.DataFrame([{"title": "Error", "link": "", "snippet": str(e), "content": ""}]))

        if not response.text or "text/html" not in response.headers.get("content-type", "").lower():
            self.status = "No results found"
            return DataFrame(
                pd.DataFrame([{"title": "Error", "link": "", "snippet": "No results found", "content": ""}])
            )

        soup = BeautifulSoup(response.text, "html.parser")
        results = []

        for result in soup.select("div.result"):
            title_tag = result.select_one("a.result__a")
            snippet_tag = result.select_one("a.result__snippet")

                parsed = urlparse(raw_link)
                uddg = parse_qs(parsed.query).get("uddg", [""])[0]
                decoded_link = unquote(uddg) if uddg else raw_link

                try:
                    final_url = self.ensure_url(decoded_link)
                    page = requests.get(final_url, headers=headers, timeout=self.timeout)
                    page.raise_for_status()
                    content = BeautifulSoup(page.text, "lxml").get_text(separator=" ", strip=True)
                except requests.RequestException as e:
                    final_url = decoded_link
                    content = f"(Failed to fetch: {e!s}"

                results.append(
                    {
                        "title": title_tag.get_text(strip=True),
                        "link": final_url,
                        "snippet": snippet_tag.get_text(strip=True) if snippet_tag else "",
                        "content": content,
                    }
                )

        return DataFrame(pd.DataFrame(results))

    def perform_news_search(self) -> DataFrame:
        """Perform Google News search."""
        query = getattr(self, "query", "")
        hl = getattr(self, "hl", "en-US") or "en-US"
        gl = getattr(self, "gl", "US") or "US"
        topic = getattr(self, "topic", None)
        location = getattr(self, "location", None)

        ceid = f"{gl}:{hl.split('-')[0]}"

        # Build RSS URL based on parameters
        if topic:
            # Topic-based feed
            base_url = f"https://news.google.com/rss/headlines/section/topic/{quote_plus(topic.upper())}"
            params = f"?hl={hl}&gl={gl}&ceid={ceid}"
            rss_url = base_url + params
        elif location:
            # Location-based feed
            base_url = f"https://news.google.com/rss/headlines/section/geo/{quote_plus(location)}"
            params = f"?hl={hl}&gl={gl}&ceid={ceid}"
            rss_url = base_url + params
        elif query:

            query_encoded = quote_plus(query)
            params = f"&hl={hl}&gl={gl}&ceid={ceid}"
            rss_url = f"{base_url}{query_encoded}{params}"
        else:
            self.status = "No search query, topic, or location provided."
            return DataFrame(
                pd.DataFrame(
                    [{"title": "Error", "link": "", "published": "", "summary": "No search parameters provided"}]
                )
            )

        try:
            response = requests.get(rss_url, timeout=self.timeout)
            response.raise_for_status()
            soup = BeautifulSoup(response.content, "xml")
            items = soup.find_all("item")
        except requests.RequestException as e:
            self.status = f"Failed to fetch news: {e}"
            return DataFrame(pd.DataFrame([{"title": "Error", "link": "", "published": "", "summary": str(e)}]))

        if not items:
            self.status = "No news articles found."
            return DataFrame(pd.DataFrame([{"title": "No articles found", "link": "", "published": "", "summary": ""}]))

        articles = []
        for item in items:
            try:
                title = self.clean_html(item.title.text if item.title else "")
                link = item.link.text if item.link else ""
                published = item.pubDate.text if item.pubDate else ""
                summary = self.clean_html(item.description.text if item.description else "")
                articles.append({"title": title, "link": link, "published": published, "summary": summary})
            except (AttributeError, ValueError, TypeError) as e:
                self.log(f"Error parsing article: {e!s}")
                continue

        return DataFrame(pd.DataFrame(articles))

    def perform_rss_read(self) -> DataFrame:
        """Read RSS feed."""
        rss_url = getattr(self, "query", "")
        if not rss_url:
            return DataFrame(
                pd.DataFrame([{"title": "Error", "link": "", "published": "", "summary": "No RSS URL provided"}])
            )

        try:
            response = requests.get(rss_url, timeout=self.timeout)
            response.raise_for_status()
            if not response.content.strip():
                msg = "Empty response received"
                raise ValueError(msg)

                msg = f"Invalid XML response: {e}"

        articles = [
            {
                "title": item.title.text if item.title else "",
                "link": item.link.text if item.link else "",
                "published": item.pubDate.text if item.pubDate else "",
                "summary": item.description.text if item.description else "",
            }
            for item in items
        ]

        # Ensure DataFrame has correct columns even if empty
        df_articles = pd.DataFrame(articles, columns=["title", "link", "published", "summary"])
        self.log(f"Fetched {len(df_articles)} articles.")
        return DataFrame(df_articles)

    def perform_search(self) -> DataFrame:
        """Main search method that routes to appropriate search function based on mode."""
        search_mode = getattr(self, "search_mode", "Web")

        if search_mode == "Web":
            return self.perform_web_search()
        if search_mode == "News":
            return self.perform_news_search()
        if search_mode == "RSS":
            return self.perform_rss_read()
        # Fallback to web search
        return self.perform_web_search()

        auto_parse: Enable automatic parsing of structured data (JSON/CSV)

    Returns:
        JSON: Converted JSON object
    """
    if isinstance(v, dict):
        return Data(v)
    if isinstance(v, Message):

def convert_to_dataframe(v: Table | Data | Message | dict, *, auto_parse: bool) -> Table:
    """Convert input to Table type.

    Args:
        v: Input to convert (Message, Data, Table, or dict)
        auto_parse: Enable automatic parsing of structured data (JSON/CSV)

    Returns:
        Table: Converted Table object
    """
    import pandas as pd

    if isinstance(v, dict):
        return DataFrame([v])
    if isinstance(v, DataFrame):
        return v
    # Handle pandas DataFrame
    if isinstance(v, pd.DataFrame):
        # Convert pandas DataFrame to our DataFrame by creating Data objects
        return DataFrame(data=v)

        data = Data(data={"text": v.data["text"]})
        return parse_structured_data(data).to_dataframe() if auto_parse else data.to_dataframe()

    return v.to_dataframe()


def parse_structured_data(data: JSON) -> JSON:
    """Parse structured data (JSON, CSV) from JSON's text field.

    Args:
        data: JSON object with text content to parse

    Returns:
        JSON: Modified JSON object with parsed content or original if parsing fails
    """
    raw_text = data.get_text() or ""
    text = raw_text.lstrip("\ufeff").strip()

    # Try JSON parsing first
    parsed_json = _try_parse_json(text)
    if parsed_json is not None:

    if _looks_like_csv(text):
        try:
            return _parse_csv_to_data(text)

            # Heuristic misfire or malformed CSV — keep original data
            return data

    return data


def _try_parse_json(text: str) -> JSON | None:
    """Try to parse text as JSON and return JSON object."""
    try:
        parsed = json.loads(text)

        if isinstance(parsed, dict):
            # Single JSON object
            return Data(data=parsed)
        if isinstance(parsed, list) and all(isinstance(item, dict) for item in parsed):
            # Array of JSON objects - create JSON with the list
            return Data(data={"records": parsed})

    except (json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError):
        pass

    return None


def _looks_like_csv(text: str) -> bool:
    """Simple heuristic to detect CSV content."""
    lines = text.strip().split("\n")
    if len(lines) < MIN_CSV_LINES:
        return False

    header_line = lines[0]
    return "," in header_line and len(lines) > 1


def _parse_csv_to_data(text: str) -> JSON:
    """Parse CSV text and return JSON object."""
    from io import StringIO

    import pandas as pd

    # Parse CSV to DataFrame, then convert to list of dicts
    parsed_df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(text))
    records = parsed_df.to_dict(orient="records")

    return Data(data={"records": records})

def convert_to_data(v: Table | Data | Message | dict, *, auto_parse: bool) -> JSON:
    """Convert input to JSON type.

    Args:
        v: Input to convert (Message, Data, Table, or dict)
        auto_parse: Enable automatic parsing of structured data (JSON/CSV)

    Returns:

    if isinstance(v, dict):
        return Data(v)
    if isinstance(v, Message):
        data = Data(data={"text": v.data["text"]})
        return parse_structured_data(data) if auto_parse else data

    return v if isinstance(v, Data) else v.to_data()


def convert_to_dataframe(v: Table | Data | Message | dict, *, auto_parse: bool) -> Table:
    """Convert input to Table type.

    Args:
        v: Input to convert (Message, Data, Table, or dict)
        auto_parse: Enable automatic parsing of structured data (JSON/CSV)

    Returns:
        Table: Converted Table object
    """
    import pandas as pd

    if isinstance(v, dict):
        return DataFrame([v])
    if isinstance(v, DataFrame):
        return v
    # Handle pandas DataFrame
    if isinstance(v, pd.DataFrame):
        # Convert pandas DataFrame to our DataFrame by creating Data objects
        return DataFrame(data=v)

    if isinstance(v, Message):
        data = Data(data={"text": v.data["text"]})
        return parse_structured_data(data).to_dataframe() if auto_parse else data.to_dataframe()
    # For other types, call to_dataframe method
    return v.to_dataframe()


def parse_structured_data(data: JSON) -> JSON:
    """Parse structured data (JSON, CSV) from JSON's text field.

    Args:
        data: JSON object with text content to parse

    Returns:
        JSON: Modified JSON object with parsed content or original if parsing fails
    """
    raw_text = data.get_text() or ""
    text = raw_text.lstrip("\ufeff").strip()

    # Try JSON parsing first
    parsed_json = _try_parse_json(text)
    if parsed_json is not None:
        return parsed_json

    # Try CSV parsing
    if _looks_like_csv(text):
        try:
            return _parse_csv_to_data(text)
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            # Heuristic misfire or malformed CSV — keep original data
            return data

    # Return original data if no parsing succeeded
    return data


def _try_parse_json(text: str) -> JSON | None:
    """Try to parse text as JSON and return JSON object."""
    try:
        parsed = json.loads(text)

        if isinstance(parsed, dict):
            # Single JSON object
            return Data(data=parsed)
        if isinstance(parsed, list) and all(isinstance(item, dict) for item in parsed):
            # Array of JSON objects - create JSON with the list
            return Data(data={"records": parsed})

    except (json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError):
        pass

    return None


def _looks_like_csv(text: str) -> bool:
    """Simple heuristic to detect CSV content."""
    lines = text.strip().split("\n")
    if len(lines) < MIN_CSV_LINES:
        return False

    header_line = lines[0]
    return "," in header_line and len(lines) > 1


def _parse_csv_to_data(text: str) -> JSON:
    """Parse CSV text and return JSON object."""
    from io import StringIO

    import pandas as pd

    # Parse CSV to DataFrame, then convert to list of dicts
    parsed_df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(text))
    records = parsed_df.to_dict(orient="records")

    return Data(data={"records": records})

class _SimpleCache:
    """TTL cache sederhana berbasis dict."""
    def __init__(self):
        self._store: dict[str, tuple[Any, float]] = {}

    def get(self, key: str) -> Any | None:
        entry = self._store.get(key)
        if entry is None:
            return None
        value, expires = entry
        if time.time() > expires:
            del self._store[key]
            return None
        return value

    def set(self, key: str, value: Any, ttl: int) -> None:
        self._store[key] = (value, time.time() + ttl)

    UA = "Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; OSINT-Langflow/1.0; +https://github.com/marc-shade/world-intel-mcp)"

    def __init__(self, timeout: float = 8.0, max_workers: int = 20):
        self.timeout = timeout
        self.cache = _SimpleCache()
        self.executor = ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=max_workers)

    def _fetch_one(self, url: str) -> str | None:
        cached = self.cache.get(f"http:{url}")
        if cached is not None:
            return cached
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={
            "User-Agent": self.UA,
            "Accept": "application/rss+xml, application/atom+xml, application/xml, text/xml, */*",
        })
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=self.timeout) as resp:
                # Batasi ukuran maksimum 2 MB per feed
                raw = resp.read(2 * 1024 * 1024)
                text = raw.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
            self.cache.set(f"http:{url}", text, ttl=300)
            return text
        except (urllib.error.URLError, urllib.error.HTTPError, TimeoutError, OSError):
            return None
        except Exception:
            return None

    def fetch_many(self, urls: list[str]) -> dict[str, str | None]:
        """Fetch banyak URL paralel."""
        results: dict[str, str | None] = {}
        futures = {self.executor.submit(self._fetch_one, u): u for u in urls}
        for future in as_completed(futures):
            url = futures[future]
            try:
                results[url] = future.result()
            except Exception:
                results[url] = None
        return results

    def shutdown(self) -> None:
        self.executor.shutdown(wait=False)


# ============================================================================
# SECTION 3 — PARSER RSS/ATOM/RDF (stdlib only)
# ============================================================================

_ATOM_NS = "{http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom}"
_RDF_NS = "{http://purl.org/rss/1.0/}"
_DC_NS = "{http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/}"
_TAG_CLEAN = re.compile(r"<[^>]+>")
_WS_CLEAN = re.compile(r"\s+")


def _clean_text(text: str | None, max_len: int = 240) -> str:
    if not text:
        return ""
    text = unescape(_TAG_CLEAN.sub(" ", text))
    text = _WS_CLEAN.sub(" ", text).strip()
    if len(text) > max_len:
        text = text[:max_len] + "..."
    return text


def _el_text(el, tag: str) -> str:
    child = el.find(tag)
    if child is None or child.text is None:
        return ""
    return child.text.strip()


def _parse_rss_item(item) -> dict:
    return {
        "title": _el_text(item, "title"),
        "link": _el_text(item, "link"),
        "summary": _el_text(item, "description") or _el_text(item, "summary"),
        "published": _el_text(item, "pubDate") or _el_text(item, "published"),
    }


def _parse_atom_entry(entry) -> dict:
    link_el = entry.find(f"{_ATOM_NS}link")
    link = ""
    if link_el is not None:
        link = link_el.get("href", "") or (link_el.text or "")
    return {
        "title": _el_text(entry, f"{_ATOM_NS}title"),
        "link": link,
        "summary": _el_text(entry, f"{_ATOM_NS}summary") or _el_text(entry, f"{_ATOM_NS}content"),
        "published": _el_text(entry, f"{_ATOM_NS}updated") or _el_text(entry, f"{_ATOM_NS}published"),
    }


def _parse_rdf_item(item) -> dict:
    return {
        "title": _el_text(item, f"{_RDF_NS}title"),
        "link": _el_text(item, f"{_RDF_NS}link"),
        "summary": _el_text(item, f"{_RDF_NS}description"),
        "published": _el_text(item, f"{_DC_NS}date"),
    }


def parse_feed(xml_text: str | None) -> list[dict]:
    """Parse RSS 2.0 / Atom / RDF menjadi list of dict."""
    if not xml_text:
        return []
    # Bersihkan BOM dan kontrol karakter
    xml_text = xml_text.strip().lstrip("\ufeff")
    xml_text = re.sub(r"[\x00-\x08\x0b\x0c\x0e-\x1f]", "", xml_text)
    try:
        root = ET.fromstring(xml_text)
    except ET.ParseError:
        return []
    except Exception:
        return []

    root_tag = root.tag.split("}")[-1].lower()
    items: list[dict] = []

    try:
        if root_tag == "feed":
            for entry in root.iter(f"{_ATOM_NS}entry"):
                items.append(_parse_atom_entry(entry))
        elif root_tag == "rdf":
            for item in root.iter(f"{_RDF_NS}item"):
                items.append(_parse_rdf_item(item))
        else:
            # RSS 2.0 atau fallback
            for item in root.iter("item"):
                items.append(_parse_rss_item(item))
    except Exception:
        return items

    return items


# ============================================================================
# SECTION 4 — LANGFLOW CUSTOM COMPONENT
# ============================================================================

ALL_CATEGORIES = sorted(FEED_REGISTRY.keys())
DEFAULT_CATEGORIES = ["finance", "geopolitics", "military", "energy", "technology"]


class OSINTNewsAggregator(Component):
    display_name = "OSINT News Aggregator"
    description = (
        "Menggabungkan ~145 RSS feed dari world-intel-osint sources "
        "(berita, AI, health, status layanan) tanpa dependensi eksternal. "
        "Output berupa teks siap pakai untuk Prompt Template."
    )
    icon = "newspaper"

    inputs = [
        MultiselectInput(
            name="categories",
            display_name="News Categories",
            info="Pilih kategori berita yang ingin diambil.",
            options=ALL_CATEGORIES,
            value=DEFAULT_CATEGORIES,
            required=True,
        ),
        IntInput(
            name="items_per_feed",
            display_name="Items per Feed",
            info="Jumlah maksimum artikel per feed.",
            value=5,
            required=True,
        ),
        IntInput(
            name="max_total",
            display_name="Max Total Items",
            info="Total maksimum artikel yang dikembalikan (untuk membatasi ukuran prompt).",
            value=60,
            required=True,
        ),
        IntInput(
            name="timeout_seconds",
            display_name="HTTP Timeout (detik)",
            info="Batas waktu per permintaan HTTP.",
            value=8,
            required=True,
        ),
        StrInput(
            name="keyword_filter",
            display_name="Keyword Filter (opsional)",
            info="Hanya kirim artikel yang mengandung salah satu kata kunci (pisahkan dengan koma). Kosongkan untuk semua.",
            value="",
            required=False,
        ),
    ]

    outputs = [
        Output(display_name="News Text", name="news_text", method="build_text"),
        Output(display_name="News Data (JSON)", name="news_data", method="build_data"),
    ]

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Output 1: teks siap pakai untuk Prompt Template
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def build_text(self) -> Data:
        result = self._run()
        return Data(data={"text": result["formatted_text"]})

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Output 2: data mentah terstruktur (JSON)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def build_data(self) -> Data:
        result = self._run()
        return Data(data=result["raw"])

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Core pipeline
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _run(self) -> dict:
        # Cache di level komponen agar tidak fetch ulang antar-output
        if hasattr(self, "_cached_result") and self._cached_result is not None:
            return self._cached_result

        categories = self.categories or DEFAULT_CATEGORIES
        items_per_feed = max(1, int(self.items_per_feed))
        max_total = max(1, int(self.max_total))
        timeout = max(2, int(self.timeout_seconds))
        keyword_filter = (self.keyword_filter or "").strip().lower()

        # 1. Kumpulkan semua URL dari kategori terpilih
        feed_specs: list[tuple[str, str, str]] = []  # (feed_name, url, category)
        for cat in categories:
            for feed_name, url in FEED_REGISTRY.get(cat, []):
                feed_specs.append((feed_name, url, cat))

        if not feed_specs:
            empty = {
                "formatted_text": "Tidak ada feed yang dipilih.",
                "raw": {"items": [], "count": 0, "categories": categories},
            }
            self._cached_result = empty
            return empty

        # 2. Fetch paralel
        fetcher = SimpleFetcher(timeout=timeout, max_workers=20)
        try:
            url_to_text = fetcher.fetch_many([u for _, u, _ in feed_specs])
        finally:
            fetcher.shutdown()

        # 3. Parse & agregasi
        all_items: list[dict] = []
        feeds_ok = 0
        feeds_failed = 0
        for feed_name, url, cat in feed_specs:
            text = url_to_text.get(url)
            parsed = parse_feed(text) if text else []
            if parsed:
                feeds_ok += 1
            else:
                feeds_failed += 1
            for entry in parsed[:items_per_feed]:
                item = {
                    "title": _clean_text(entry.get("title"), 200),
                    "link": entry.get("link", ""),
                    "summary": _clean_text(entry.get("summary"), 240),
                    "published": entry.get("published", ""),
                    "feed_name": feed_name,
                    "category": cat,
                }
                # Filter keyword opsional
                if keyword_filter:
                    haystack = f"{item['title']} {item['summary']}".lower()
                    if keyword_filter not in haystack:
                        continue
                all_items.append(item)

        # 4. Urutkan & batasi
        all_items.sort(key=lambda x: x.get("published") or "", reverse=True)
        all_items = all_items[:max_total]

        # 5. Format teks untuk Prompt Template
        formatted = self._format_for_prompt(all_items, categories, feeds_ok, feeds_failed)

        result = {
            "formatted_text": formatted,
            "raw": {
                "items": all_items,
                "count": len(all_items),
                "categories": list(categories),
                "feeds_ok": feeds_ok,
                "feeds_failed": feeds_failed,
                "generated_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
            },
        }
        self._cached_result = result
        return result

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Format teks agar rapi saat masuk ke Prompt Template
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _format_for_prompt(
        self,
        items: list[dict],
        categories: list[str],
        feeds_ok: int,
        feeds_failed: int,
    ) -> str:
        if not items:
            return "Tidak ada artikel berita yang berhasil diambil."

        lines: list[str] = []
        lines.append(f"=== OSINT NEWS DIGEST ===")
        lines.append(f"Kategori: {', '.join(categories)}")
        lines.append(f"Total artikel: {len(items)} (feed OK: {feeds_ok}, gagal: {feeds_failed})")
        lines.append("")

        for i, item in enumerate(items, 1):
            lines.append(f"[{i}] {item['title']}")
            if item.get("category"):
                lines.append(f"    Kategori : {item['category']}")
            if item.get("feed_name"):
                lines.append(f"    Sumber   : {item['feed_name']}")
            if item.get("published"):
                lines.append(f"    Tanggal  : {item['published']}")
            if item.get("summary"):
                lines.append(f"    Ringkas  : {item['summary']}")
            lines.append("")

        return "\n".join(lines)


# ============================================================================
# SECTION 5 — DEMO CLI (opsional, jalankan manual untuk uji di luar Langflow)
# ============================================================================

if __name__ == "__main__":
    # Test tanpa Langflow: gunakan stub minimal
    class _Stub:
        categories = DEFAULT_CATEGORIES
        items_per_feed = 3
        max_total = 15
        timeout_seconds = 8
        keyword_filter = ""
        _cached_result = None
        build_text = OSINTNewsAggregator.build_text
        build_data = OSINTNewsAggregator.build_data
        _run = OSINTNewsAggregator._run
        _format_for_prompt = OSINTNewsAggregator._format_for_prompt

    stub = _Stub()
    out = stub._run()
    print(out["formatted_text"])
    print(f"\n--- Total items: {out['raw']['count']} ---")

import json
from typing import Any

from lfx.custom import Component
from lfx.io import BoolInput, HandleInput, Output, TabInput
from lfx.schema import Data, DataFrame, Message
from lfx.schema.data import JSON
from lfx.schema.dataframe import Table

MIN_CSV_LINES = 2


def convert_to_message(v) -> Message:
    """Convert input to Message type.

    Args:
        v: Input to convert (Message, Data, DataFrame, or dict)

    Returns:
        Message: Converted Message object
    """
    return v if isinstance(v, Message) else v.to_message()


def convert_to_data(v: Table | Data | Message | dict, *, auto_parse: bool) -> JSON:
    """Convert input to JSON type.

    Args:
        v: Input to convert (Message, Data, Table, or dict)
        auto_parse: Enable automatic parsing of structured data (JSON/CSV)

    Returns:
        JSON: Converted JSON object
    """
    if isinstance(v, dict):
        return Data(v)
    if isinstance(v, Message):
        data = Data(data={"text": v.data["text"]})
        return parse_structured_data(data) if auto_parse else data

    return v if isinstance(v, Data) else v.to_data()


def convert_to_dataframe(v: Table | Data | Message | dict, *, auto_parse: bool) -> Table:
    """Convert input to Table type.

    Args:
        v: Input to convert (Message, Data, Table, or dict)
        auto_parse: Enable automatic parsing of structured data (JSON/CSV)

    Returns:
        Table: Converted Table object
    """
    import pandas as pd

    if isinstance(v, dict):
        return DataFrame([v])
    if isinstance(v, DataFrame):
        return v
    # Handle pandas DataFrame
    if isinstance(v, pd.DataFrame):
        # Convert pandas DataFrame to our DataFrame by creating Data objects
        return DataFrame(data=v)

    if isinstance(v, Message):
        data = Data(data={"text": v.data["text"]})
        return parse_structured_data(data).to_dataframe() if auto_parse else data.to_dataframe()
    # For other types, call to_dataframe method
    return v.to_dataframe()


def parse_structured_data(data: JSON) -> JSON:
    """Parse structured data (JSON, CSV) from JSON's text field.

    Args:
        data: JSON object with text content to parse

    Returns:
        JSON: Modified JSON object with parsed content or original if parsing fails
    """
    raw_text = data.get_text() or ""
    text = raw_text.lstrip("\ufeff").strip()

    # Try JSON parsing first
    parsed_json = _try_parse_json(text)
    if parsed_json is not None:
        return parsed_json

    # Try CSV parsing
    if _looks_like_csv(text):
        try:
            return _parse_csv_to_data(text)
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            # Heuristic misfire or malformed CSV — keep original data
            return data

    # Return original data if no parsing succeeded
    return data


def _try_parse_json(text: str) -> JSON | None:
    """Try to parse text as JSON and return JSON object."""
    try:
        parsed = json.loads(text)

        if isinstance(parsed, dict):
            # Single JSON object
            return Data(data=parsed)
        if isinstance(parsed, list) and all(isinstance(item, dict) for item in parsed):
            # Array of JSON objects - create JSON with the list
            return Data(data={"records": parsed})

    except (json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError):
        pass

    return None


def _looks_like_csv(text: str) -> bool:
    """Simple heuristic to detect CSV content."""
    lines = text.strip().split("\n")
    if len(lines) < MIN_CSV_LINES:
        return False

    header_line = lines[0]
    return "," in header_line and len(lines) > 1


def _parse_csv_to_data(text: str) -> JSON:
    """Parse CSV text and return JSON object."""
    from io import StringIO

    import pandas as pd

    # Parse CSV to DataFrame, then convert to list of dicts
    parsed_df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(text))
    records = parsed_df.to_dict(orient="records")

    return Data(data={"records": records})


class TypeConverterComponent(Component):
    display_name = "Type Convert"
    description = "Convert between different types (Message, JSON, Table)"
    documentation: str = "https://docs.langflow.org/type-convert"
    icon = "repeat"

    inputs = [
        HandleInput(
            name="input_data",
            display_name="Input",
            input_types=["Message", "Data", "JSON", "DataFrame", "Table"],
            info="Accept Message, JSON or Table as input",
            required=True,
        ),
        BoolInput(
            name="auto_parse",
            display_name="Auto Parse",
            info="Detect and convert JSON/CSV strings automatically.",
            advanced=True,
            value=False,
            required=False,
        ),
        TabInput(
            name="output_type",
            display_name="Output Type",
            options=["Message", "JSON", "Table"],
            info="Select the desired output data type",
            real_time_refresh=True,
            value="Message",
        ),
    ]

    # Define ALL outputs so they exist during validation
    # update_frontend_node will filter to show only the selected one
    outputs = [
        Output(
            display_name="Message Output",
            name="message_output",
            method="convert_to_message",
            types=["Message"],
        ),
        Output(
            display_name="JSON Output",
            name="data_output",
            method="convert_to_data",
            types=["JSON"],
        ),
        Output(
            display_name="Table Output",
            name="dataframe_output",
            method="convert_to_dataframe",
            types=["Table"],
        ),
    ]

    async def update_frontend_node(self, new_frontend_node: dict, current_frontend_node: dict):
        """Ensure outputs are synced with output_type when component is loaded."""
        # Call parent implementation first
        await super().update_frontend_node(new_frontend_node, current_frontend_node)

        # Then sync outputs with current output_type value
        output_type = new_frontend_node.get("template", {}).get("output_type", {}).get("value", "Message")
        self.update_outputs(new_frontend_node, "output_type", output_type)

        return new_frontend_node

    def update_outputs(self, frontend_node: dict, field_name: str, field_value: Any) -> dict:
        """Dynamically show only the relevant output based on the selected output type."""
        if field_name == "output_type":
            # Start with empty outputs
            frontend_node["outputs"] = []

            # Add only the selected output type WITH TYPES SPECIFIED
            if field_value == "Message":
                frontend_node["outputs"].append(
                    Output(
                        display_name="Message Output",
                        name="message_output",
                        method="convert_to_message",
                        types=["Message"],
                    ).to_dict()
                )
            elif field_value in ("Data", "JSON"):
                frontend_node["outputs"].append(
                    Output(
                        display_name="JSON Output",
                        name="data_output",
                        method="convert_to_data",
                        types=["JSON"],
                    ).to_dict()
                )
            elif field_value in ("DataFrame", "Table"):
                frontend_node["outputs"].append(
                    Output(
                        display_name="Table Output",
                        name="dataframe_output",
                        method="convert_to_dataframe",
                        types=["Table"],
                    ).to_dict()
                )

        return frontend_node

    def convert_to_message(self) -> Message:
        """Convert input to Message type."""
        input_value = self.input_data[0] if isinstance(self.input_data, list) else self.input_data

        # Handle string input by converting to Message first
        if isinstance(input_value, str):
            input_value = Message(text=input_value)

        result = convert_to_message(input_value)
        self.status = result
        return result

    def convert_to_data(self) -> JSON:
        """Convert input to JSON type."""
        input_value = self.input_data[0] if isinstance(self.input_data, list) else self.input_data

        # Handle string input by converting to Message first
        if isinstance(input_value, str):
            input_value = Message(text=input_value)

        result = convert_to_data(input_value, auto_parse=self.auto_parse)
        self.status = result
        return result

    def convert_to_dataframe(self) -> Table:
        """Convert input to Table type."""
        input_value = self.input_data[0] if isinstance(self.input_data, list) else self.input_data

        # Handle string input by converting to Message first
        if isinstance(input_value, str):
            input_value = Message(text=input_value)

        result = convert_to_dataframe(input_value, auto_parse=self.auto_parse)
        self.status = result
        return result

Menggabungkan Price History Fetcher + Impact Projector menjadi SATU komponen.

Output: laporan markdown final (narasi + tabel proyeksi kuantitatif)

Zero external dependencies (stdlib only).

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import math
import re

import time

from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from lfx.custom.custom_component.component import Component
from lfx.io import IntInput, MultilineInput, Output, StrInput

}

# Kalibrasi

def _load_calibration(path: str) -> dict:
    """Baca calibration.json. Jika tidak ada, kembalikan default 1.0×."""
    import os as _os
    if not path or not _os.path.exists(path):
        return {
            "ci_multiplier": 1.0,
            "magnitude_multiplier": 1.0,
            "min_signal_strength": 1,
            "reason": "no_calibration_file",
        }
    try:
        import json as _json
        with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            data = _json.load(f)
        if not isinstance(data, dict):
            raise ValueError("invalid calibration")
        return {
            "ci_multiplier": float(data.get("ci_multiplier", 1.0)),
            "magnitude_multiplier": float(data.get("magnitude_multiplier", 1.0)),
            "min_signal_strength": int(data.get("min_signal_strength", 1)),
            "reason": data.get("reason", "unknown"),
        }
    except Exception:
        return {

_PRICE_CACHE: dict[str, tuple[dict, float]] = {}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper matematis
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _log_returns(closes: list[float]) -> list[float]:
    return [
        math.log(closes[i] / closes[i - 1])
        for i in range(1, len(closes))
        if closes[i - 1] > 0 and closes[i] > 0
    ]


def _stdev(values: list[float]) -> float:
    return statistics.pstdev(values) if len(values) >= 2 else 0.0


def _mean(values: list[float]) -> float:
    return statistics.fmean(values) if values else 0.0


def _beta(stock_ret: list[float], market_ret: list[float]) -> float:
    n = min(len(stock_ret), len(market_ret))
    if n < 20:
        return 1.0
    s, m = stock_ret[-n:], market_ret[-n:]
    ms, mm = _mean(s), _mean(m)
    cov = sum((s[i] - ms) * (m[i] - mm) for i in range(n)) / n
    var_m = sum((x - mm) ** 2 for x in m) / n
    return cov / var_m if var_m > 1e-12 else 1.0


def _percentile(sorted_vals: list[float], q: float) -> float:
    if not sorted_vals:
        return 0.0
    if len(sorted_vals) == 1:
        return sorted_vals[0]
    pos = q * (len(sorted_vals) - 1)
    lo, hi = int(math.floor(pos)), int(math.ceil(pos))
    if lo == hi:
        return sorted_vals[lo]
    frac = pos - lo
    return sorted_vals[lo] * (1 - frac) + sorted_vals[hi] * frac


def _decay_curve(peak: int, tau: float, days: int = 10) -> list[float]:
    out = []
    for t in range(days + 1):
        if t <= peak:
            out.append(t / peak if peak > 0 else 1.0)
        else:
            out.append(math.exp(-(t - peak) / tau))
    return out


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Komponen utama
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class QuantitativeProjector(Component):
    display_name = "Quantitative Projector"
    description = (
        "Menggabungkan ekstraksi JSON dari output LLM + fetching harga historis "
        "+ proyeksi kuantitatif dalam satu komponen. Menggantikan 2 node terpisah."
    )
    icon = "chart-line"

    inputs = [
        MultilineInput(
            name="llm_output",
            display_name="LLM Output",
            info="Output dari Language Model Stage 1 (mengandung markdown + blok JSON terstruktur).",
            required=True,
        ),
        StrInput(
            name="benchmark",
            display_name="Benchmark Ticker",
            info="Ticker benchmark untuk perhitungan beta.",
            value="SPY",
            required=True,
        ),
        StrInput(
            name="price_range",
            display_name="Price Range",
            info="1mo, 3mo, 6mo, 1y, 2y",
            value="6mo",
            required=True,
        ),
        IntInput(
            name="forecast_days",
            display_name="Forecast Days",
            value=10,
        ),
        IntInput(
            name="max_tickers",
            display_name="Max Tickers to Analyze",
            info="Batasi jumlah ticker agar cepat. Ticker diurutkan berdasarkan |point move|.",
            value=15,
        ),
        StrInput(
            name="calibration_path",
            display_name="Calibration Path",
            info="Path ke calibration.json. Kosongkan untuk pakai default.",
            value=_CALIBRATION_DEFAULT_PATH,
            required=False,
        ),
    ]

    outputs = [
        Output(display_name="Final Report", name="report", method="build_report"),
        Output(display_name="Projection Data (JSON)", name="data", method="build_data"),
    ]

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Output builders
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def build_report(self) -> Message:
        result = self._cached_run()
        return Message(text=result["final_markdown"])

    def build_data(self) -> Data:
        result = self._cached_run()
        return Data(data=result)

    def _cached_run(self) -> dict:
        if not hasattr(self, "_cache_result") or self._cache_result is None:
            self._cache_result = self._run()
        return self._cache_result

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Core pipeline
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _run(self) -> dict:
        raw = self.llm_output or ""
        # Load kalibrasi
        self._calibration = _load_calibration(self.calibration_path)
        if isinstance(raw, Data):
            raw = raw.data.get("text", "") if isinstance(raw.data, dict) else str(raw.data)
        if not isinstance(raw, str):
            raw = str(raw)

        narrative, signals = self._split_output(raw)
        # Filter berdasarkan min signal strength dari kalibrasi
        min_ss = self._calibration.get("min_signal_strength", 1)
        current_ss = signals.get("signal_strength", 10) if signals else 10
        if current_ss < min_ss:
            return {
                "error": f"Signal strength {current_ss} < minimum {min_ss}. "
                         f"Prediksi di-skip oleh kalibrasi.",
                "final_markdown": (
                    f"# ⚠️ Prediksi Di-skip oleh Kalibrasi\n\n"
                    f"Signal strength saat ini **{current_ss}**, sedangkan threshold "
                    f"minimum dari kalibrasi adalah **{min_ss}**.\n\n"
                    f"Sistem memutuskan untuk tidak memproses prediksi ini karena "
                    f"tier signal strength ini historis tidak menguntungkan."
                ),
                "projections": [],
            }
        if signals is None:
            return {
                "error": "JSON block not found in LLM output. Pastikan prompt Stage 1 menyertakan instruksi ---JSON_START--- / ---JSON_END---.",
                "final_markdown": narrative + "\n\n> ⚠️ Proyeksi kuantitatif tidak dapat dihitung: blok JSON tidak ditemukan.",
                "projections": [],
            }

        # Kumpulkan ticker unik dari kedua bucket
        tickers: set[str] = set()
        for bucket in ("sectors_benefited", "sectors_harmed"):
            for entry in signals.get(bucket, []) or []:
                for t in entry.get("tickers", []) or []:
                    t_clean = re.sub(r"[^A-Z0-9.\-]", "", str(t).upper())
                    if t_clean and len(t_clean) <= 6:
                        tickers.add(t_clean)

        tickers.add(self.benchmark.upper())
        tickers_list = sorted(tickers)

        # Fetch harga paralel
        prices = self._fetch_prices(tickers_list)

        # Hitung proyeksi
        projections = self._project(signals, prices)
        projections.sort(key=lambda x: abs(x["point_move_pct"]), reverse=True)
        projections = projections[: self.max_tickers]

        # Gabungkan narasi + tabel proyeksi
        final_md = self._compose_final(narrative, projections, signals)

        return {
            "generated_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
            "signal_strength": signals.get("signal_strength"),
            "market_summary": signals.get("market_summary"),
            "tickers_analyzed": tickers_list,
            "projections": projections,
            "final_markdown": final_md,
            "count": len(projections),
        }

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Split LLM output → narrative + JSON
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _split_output(self, raw: str) -> tuple[str, dict | None]:
        match = _JSON_BLOCK_RE.search(raw)
        if not match:
            # Fallback: cari JSON object pertama
            return raw, self._fallback_json_extract(raw)

        json_str = match.group(1)
        try:
            signals = json.loads(json_str)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            signals = self._fallback_json_extract(raw)

        narrative = _JSON_BLOCK_RE.sub("", raw).strip()
        return narrative, signals

    def _fallback_json_extract(self, raw: str) -> dict | None:
        # Cari blok { ... } yang mengandung "sectors_benefited"
        for m in re.finditer(r"\{", raw):
            try:
                decoder = json.JSONDecoder()
                obj, _ = decoder.raw_decode(raw[m.start():])
                if isinstance(obj, dict) and "sectors_benefited" in obj:
                    return obj
            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                continue
        return None

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Fetch harga paralel (stdlib only)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _fetch_prices(self, tickers: list[str]) -> dict[str, dict]:
        results: dict[str, dict] = {}
        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=8) as pool:
            futures = {pool.submit(self._fetch_one, s): s for s in tickers}
            for fut in as_completed(futures):
                sym = futures[fut]
                try:
                    data = fut.result()
                    if data:
                        results[sym] = data
                except Exception:
                    continue
        return results

    def _fetch_one(self, symbol: str) -> dict | None:
        cache_key = f"{symbol}:{self.price_range}"
        cached = _PRICE_CACHE.get(cache_key)
        if cached and time.time() < cached[1]:
            return cached[0]

        url = (
            f"https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/{symbol}"
            f"?range={self.price_range}&interval=1d"
        )
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": _UA})
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10) as resp:
                raw = resp.read(2 * 1024 * 1024)
            payload = json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8", errors="replace"))
        except (urllib.error.URLError, urllib.error.HTTPError,
                TimeoutError, OSError, json.JSONDecodeError):
            return None

        try:
            result = payload["chart"]["result"][0]
            timestamps = result.get("timestamp") or []
            quote = result["indicators"]["quote"][0]
            closes = quote.get("close") or []
        except (KeyError, IndexError, TypeError):
            return None

        clean_closes = [
            float(closes[i]) for i in range(len(timestamps))
            if i < len(closes) and closes[i] is not None and closes[i] > 0
        ]

        if len(clean_closes) < 30:
            return None

        data = {"symbol": symbol, "closes": clean_closes}
        _PRICE_CACHE[cache_key] = (data, time.time() + _PRICE_CACHE_TTL)
        return data

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Hitung proyeksi
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _project(self, signals: dict, prices: dict) -> list[dict]:
        benchmark_closes = (prices.get(self.benchmark.upper()) or {}).get("closes") or []
        market_returns = _log_returns(benchmark_closes) if len(benchmark_closes) >= 30 else []

        projections: list[dict] = []
        for bucket, direction in [("sectors_benefited", +1), ("sectors_harmed", -1)]:
            for entry in signals.get(bucket, []) or []:
                magnitude = _MAGNITUDE_FACTOR.get(
                    (entry.get("impact_magnitude") or "").strip().lower(), 0.5
                )
                timing_key = (entry.get("timing") or "").strip().lower()
                peak = _TIMING_PEAK_DAY.get(timing_key, 2)
                tau = _TIMING_TAU.get(timing_key, 5.0)

                for ticker in entry.get("tickers", []) or []:
                    ticker = re.sub(r"[^A-Z0-9.\-]", "", str(ticker).upper())
                    proj = self._compute_one(
                        ticker, direction, magnitude, peak, tau,
                        prices, market_returns,
                    )
                    if proj:
                        proj["sector"] = entry.get("sector", "")
                        proj["bucket"] = bucket
                        projections.append(proj)

        # Dedup
        dedup: dict[str, dict] = {}
        for p in projections:
            t = p["ticker"]
            if t not in dedup or abs(p["point_move_pct"]) > abs(dedup[t]["point_move_pct"]):
                dedup[t] = p
        return list(dedup.values())

    def _compute_one(
        self, ticker: str, direction: int, magnitude: float,
        peak: int, tau: float, prices: dict, market_returns: list[float],
    ) -> dict | None:
        if ticker not in prices:
            return None
        closes = prices[ticker]["closes"]
        if len(closes) < 30:
            return None

        returns = _log_returns(closes)
        if len(returns) < 20:
            return None

        recent_vol = _stdev(returns[-20:])
        if recent_vol <= 0:
            return None

        beta = _beta(returns, market_returns) if market_returns else 1.0
        beta = max(0.3, min(beta, 3.0))

        horizon = max(1, peak)
        horizon_vol = recent_vol * math.sqrt(horizon)

        # Terapkan kalibrasi (default 1.0 jika tidak ada file)
        ci_mult = self._calibration.get("ci_multiplier", 1.0)
        mag_mult = self._calibration.get("magnitude_multiplier", 1.0)

        point = direction * magnitude * horizon_vol * beta * 100.0 * mag_mult
        ci_half = 1.28 * horizon_vol * beta * 100.0 * ci_mult

        # Historical analog
        analogs = sorted(
            sum(returns[i:i + horizon]) * 100.0
            for i in range(0, len(returns) - horizon)
        )

        return {
            "ticker": ticker,
            "direction": "Bullish" if direction > 0 else "Bearish",
            "beta": round(beta, 3),
            "daily_vol_pct": round(recent_vol * 100, 3),
            "horizon_days": horizon,
            "point_move_pct": round(point, 2),
            "ci_80_low_pct": round(point - ci_half, 2),
            "ci_80_high_pct": round(point + ci_half, 2),
            "historical_analog": {
                "n_windows": len(analogs),
                "p25_pct": round(_percentile(analogs, 0.25), 2),
                "p50_pct": round(_percentile(analogs, 0.50), 2),
                "p75_pct": round(_percentile(analogs, 0.75), 2),
            },
            "decay_curve": [round(x, 3) for x in _decay_curve(peak, tau, self.forecast_days)],
        }

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Compose final markdown
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _compose_final(self, narrative: str, projections: list[dict], signals: dict) -> str:
        lines: list[str] = []
        lines.append(narrative.strip())
        lines.append("")
        lines.append("---")
        lines.append("")
        lines.append("# 📊 Quantitative Impact Projection")
        lines.append("")
        lines.append(f"_Generated: {datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M UTC')}_")
        lines.append("")

        if not projections:
            lines.append("⚠️ Tidak ada proyeksi yang dapat dihitung (data harga tidak tersedia atau ticker tidak valid).")
            return "\n".join(lines)

        lines.append("## Top Priority Projections")
        lines.append("")
        lines.append("| Rank | Ticker | Direction | Sector | Point Move | 80% CI | β | Vol/day | Peak |")
        lines.append("|------|--------|-----------|--------|-----------|--------|---|---------|------|")
        for i, p in enumerate(projections, 1):
            ci = f"[{p['ci_80_low_pct']:+.2f}%, {p['ci_80_high_pct']:+.2f}%]"
            lines.append(
                f"| {i} | **{p['ticker']}** | {p['direction']} | {p['sector'][:22]} | "
                f"**{p['point_move_pct']:+.2f}%** | {ci} | {p['beta']} | "
                f"{p['daily_vol_pct']}% | D+{p['horizon_days']} |"
            )
        lines.append("")

        lines.append("## Detail per Ticker (Top 5)")
        lines.append("")
        for p in projections[:5]:
            a = p["historical_analog"]
            curve = " → ".join(f"{v:.2f}" for v in p["decay_curve"][:8])
            lines.append(f"### {p['ticker']} — {p['direction']}")
            lines.append(f"- **Sector:** {p['sector']}")
            lines.append(f"- **Point estimate:** {p['point_move_pct']:+.2f}%")
            lines.append(f"- **80% CI:** [{p['ci_80_low_pct']:+.2f}%, {p['ci_80_high_pct']:+.2f}%]")
            lines.append(f"- **β (vs {self.benchmark}):** {p['beta']}")
            lines.append(f"- **Realized daily vol (20d):** {p['daily_vol_pct']}%")
            lines.append(f"- **Expected peak:** D+{p['horizon_days']}")
            lines.append(
                f"- **Historical analog ({a['n_windows']} windows):** "
                f"P25={a['p25_pct']:+.2f}%, P50={a['p50_pct']:+.2f}%, P75={a['p75_pct']:+.2f}%"
            )
            lines.append(f"- **Decay curve (D0..D7):** {curve}")
            lines.append("")

        lines.append("## How to Read This")
        lines.append("")
        lines.append("- **Point Move:** expected % move = direction × magnitude × realized vol × √horizon × β")
        lines.append("- **80% CI:** interval kepercayaan; harga aktual diharapkan berada di dalamnya 80% dari waktu")
        lines.append("- **Historical Analog:** distribusi return historis pada horizon yang sama")
        lines.append("- **Decay Curve:** dampak relatif per hari (1.0 = puncak)")
        return "\n".join(lines)

"""
CalibrationEngine — Langflow Custom Component (Stage 4)
========================================================
Membaca metrics dari file storage Stage 3, menghitung multiplier kalibrasi,
dan menyimpannya ke calibration.json untuk dikonsumsi Quantitative Projector.

Zero external dependencies (stdlib only).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

from lfx.custom.custom_component.component import Component
from lfx.io import IntInput, Output, StrInput
from lfx.schema import Data, Message


_DEFAULT_CALIBRATION = os.path.expanduser("~/.langflow_calibration.json")
_DEFAULT_STORAGE = os.path.expanduser("~/.langflow_osint_predictions.json")


def _now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


def _clip(value: float, lo: float, hi: float) -> float:
    return max(lo, min(hi, value))


def _load_json(path: str) -> dict:
    p = Path(path)
    if not p.exists():
        return {}
    try:
        with p.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            data = json.load(f)
        return data if isinstance(data, dict) else {}
    except (json.JSONDecodeError, OSError):
        return {}


def _save_json(path: str, data: dict) -> None:
    p = Path(path)
    p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    tmp = p.with_suffix(p.suffix + ".tmp")
    with tmp.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(data, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False, default=str)
    tmp.replace(p)


class CalibrationEngine(Component):
    display_name = "Calibration Engine (Stage 4)"
    description = (
        "Menghitung multiplier kalibrasi dari akurasi historis. "
        "Output ditulis ke calibration.json untuk dibaca Quantitative Projector."
    )
    icon = "adjustments"

    inputs = [
        StrInput(
            name="storage_path",
            display_name="Storage Path (Stage 3)",
            value=_DEFAULT_STORAGE,
            required=True,
        ),
        StrInput(
            name="calibration_path",
            display_name="Calibration Output Path",
            value=_DEFAULT_CALIBRATION,
            required=True,
        ),
        IntInput(
            name="min_sample_size",
            display_name="Min Sample Size",
            info="Jumlah minimal evaluasi sebelum kalibrasi aktif.",
            value=20,
            required=True,
        ),
        StrInput(
            name="mode",
            display_name="Mode",
            info="analyze (hitung & simpan) | reset (kembalikan ke default)",
            value="analyze",
            required=True,
        ),
    ]

    outputs = [
        Output(display_name="Report", name="report", method="build_report"),
        Output(display_name="Calibration Data (JSON)", name="calibration", method="build_data"),
    ]

    def build_report(self) -> Message:
        return Message(text=self._cached_run()["report_md"])

    def build_data(self) -> Data:
        return Data(data=self._cached_run()["calibration"])

    def _cached_run(self) -> dict:
        if not hasattr(self, "_cache") or self._cache is None:
            self._cache = self._run()
        return self._cache

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _run(self) -> dict:
        mode = (self.mode or "analyze").strip().lower()

        if mode == "reset":
            default = self._default_calibration(reason="Manual reset")
            _save_json(self.calibration_path, default)
            return {
                "report_md": "# 🔄 Calibration Reset\n\nKalibrasi dikembalikan ke default (1.0×).",
                "calibration": default,
            }

        # Load metrics dari Stage 3
        store = _load_json(self.storage_path)
        metrics = store.get("metrics", {}) or {}
        total_eval = metrics.get("total_evaluated", 0)

        if total_eval < self.min_sample_size:
            calibration = self._default_calibration(
                reason=f"Insufficient data ({total_eval}/{self.min_sample_size})"
            )
            _save_json(self.calibration_path, calibration)
            return {
                "report_md": self._render_insufficient_report(metrics, total_eval),
                "calibration": calibration,
            }

        # Hitung multiplier
        ci_mult = self._compute_ci_multiplier(metrics)
        mag_mult = self._compute_magnitude_multiplier(metrics)
        min_ss = self._compute_min_signal_strength(metrics)

        calibration = {
            "calibration_version": 1,
            "generated_at": _now_iso(),
            "reason": "auto_calibrated",
            "sample_size": total_eval,
            "ci_multiplier": round(ci_mult, 3),
            "magnitude_multiplier": round(mag_mult, 3),
            "min_signal_strength": min_ss,
            "metrics_snapshot": {
                "mae": metrics.get("mean_absolute_error"),
                "hit_rate": metrics.get("direction_hit_rate"),
                "ci_coverage": metrics.get("ci_coverage_rate"),
            },
        }
        _save_json(self.calibration_path, calibration)

        report = self._render_report(calibration, metrics)
        return {"report_md": report, "calibration": calibration}

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _default_calibration(self, reason: str) -> dict:
        return {
            "calibration_version": 1,
            "generated_at": _now_iso(),
            "reason": reason,
            "sample_size": 0,
            "ci_multiplier": 1.0,
            "magnitude_multiplier": 1.0,
            "min_signal_strength": 1,
        }

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _compute_ci_multiplier(self, metrics: dict) -> float:
        """
        Target CI coverage = 0.80.
        Jika coverage terlalu rendah → perlebar CI (multiplier > 1).
        Jika coverage terlalu tinggi → persempit CI (multiplier < 1).
        """
        coverage = metrics.get("ci_coverage_rate")
        if coverage is None:
            return 1.0
        target = 0.80
        raw = target / max(coverage, 0.30)
        return _clip(raw, 0.70, 1.80)

    def _compute_magnitude_multiplier(self, metrics: dict) -> float:
        """
        Berdasarkan Direction Hit Rate.
        - Hit rate rendah (< 0.50) → tidak ada edge → kecilkan magnitude.
        - Hit rate tinggi (> 0.60) → edge kuat → perbesar magnitude (hati-hati).
        """
        hit = metrics.get("direction_hit_rate")
        if hit is None:
            return 1.0
        if hit < 0.40:
            return 0.60
        if hit < 0.45:
            return 0.75
        if hit < 0.50:
            return 0.85
        if hit < 0.55:
            return 1.00
        if hit < 0.60:
            return 1.05
        if hit < 0.65:
            return 1.10
        return 1.20

    def _compute_min_signal_strength(self, metrics: dict) -> int:
        """
        Filter tier signal strength yang tidak punya edge.
        Tier terendah dengan hit rate >= 0.55 dan n >= 5 dijadikan threshold.
        """
        by_ss = metrics.get("by_signal_strength", {}) or {}
        if not by_ss:
            return 1

        # Urutkan tier: "1-3", "4-6", "7-8", "9-10"
        order = ["1-3 (Weak)", "4-6 (Moderate)", "7-8 (Strong)", "9-10 (Very Strong)"]
        threshold = 1
        for tier_label in order:
            data = by_ss.get(tier_label)
            if not data or data.get("n", 0) < 5:
                continue
            if data.get("hit_rate", 0) >= 0.55:
                # Tier ini layak, threshold minimalnya adalah angka bawah
                if "1-3" in tier_label:
                    threshold = 1
                elif "4-6" in tier_label:
                    threshold = 4
                elif "7-8" in tier_label:
                    threshold = 7
                else:
                    threshold = 9
                break
        else:
            # Tidak ada tier yang layak, naikkan threshold ke 7
            threshold = 7
        return threshold

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _render_insufficient_report(self, metrics: dict, total_eval: int) -> str:
        lines = ["# 🔄 Calibration Status", ""]
        lines.append(f"**Status:** ⏳ Insufficient data")
        lines.append(f"**Samples:** {total_eval} / {self.min_sample_size}")
        lines.append("")
        lines.append("Kalibrasi akan otomatis aktif setelah cukup data terkumpul.")
        lines.append("")
        lines.append("**Saat ini sistem menggunakan default:**")
        lines.append("- CI multiplier: **1.00×**")
        lines.append("- Magnitude multiplier: **1.00×**")
        lines.append("- Min signal strength: **1**")
        return "\n".join(lines)

    def _render_report(self, cal: dict, metrics: dict) -> str:
        lines = ["# 🔄 Auto-Calibration Report", ""]
        lines.append(f"_Generated: {cal['generated_at']}_")
        lines.append(f"**Sample size:** {cal['sample_size']}")
        lines.append(f"**Reason:** {cal['reason']}")
        lines.append("")

        mae = metrics.get("mean_absolute_error")
        hit = metrics.get("direction_hit_rate")

from typing import Any

from lfx.base.prompts.api_utils import process_prompt_template
from lfx.custom.custom_component.component import Component
from lfx.inputs.input_mixin import FieldTypes
from lfx.inputs.inputs import DefaultPromptField
from lfx.io import BoolInput, MessageTextInput, Output, PromptInput
from lfx.log.logger import logger
from lfx.schema.dotdict import dotdict
from lfx.schema.message import Message
from lfx.template.utils import update_template_values
from lfx.utils.mustache_security import validate_mustache_template


class PromptComponent(Component):
    display_name: str = "Prompt Template"
    description: str = "Create a prompt template with dynamic variables."
    documentation: str = "https://docs.langflow.org/components-prompts"
    icon = "prompts"
    trace_type = "prompt"
    name = "Prompt Template"

    inputs = [
        PromptInput(name="template", display_name="Template"),
        BoolInput(
            name="use_double_brackets",
            display_name="Use Double Brackets",
            value=False,
            advanced=True,
            info="Use {{variable}} syntax instead of {variable}.",
            real_time_refresh=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="tool_placeholder",
            display_name="Tool Placeholder",
            tool_mode=True,
            advanced=True,
            show=False,
            info="A placeholder input for tool mode.",
        ),
    ]

    outputs = [
        Output(display_name="Prompt", name="prompt", method="build_prompt"),
    ]

    def update_build_config(self, build_config: dotdict, field_value: Any, field_name: str | None = None) -> dotdict:
        """Update the template field type based on the selected mode."""
        if field_name == "use_double_brackets":
            # Change the template field type based on mode
            is_mustache = field_value is True
            if is_mustache:
                build_config["template"]["type"] = FieldTypes.MUSTACHE_PROMPT.value
            else:
                build_config["template"]["type"] = FieldTypes.PROMPT.value

            # Re-process the template to update variables when mode changes
            template_value = build_config.get("template", {}).get("value", "")
            if template_value:
                # Ensure custom_fields is properly initialized
                if "custom_fields" not in build_config:
                    build_config["custom_fields"] = {}

                # Clean up fields from the OLD mode before processing with NEW mode
                # This ensures we don't keep fields with wrong syntax even if validation fails
                old_custom_fields = build_config["custom_fields"].get("template", [])
                for old_field in list(old_custom_fields):
                    # Remove the field from custom_fields and template
                    if old_field in old_custom_fields:
                        old_custom_fields.remove(old_field)
                    build_config.pop(old_field, None)

                # Try to process template with new mode to add new variables
                # If validation fails, at least we cleaned up old fields
                try:
                    # Validate mustache templates for security
                    if is_mustache:
                        validate_mustache_template(template_value)

                    # Re-process template with new mode to add new variables
                    _ = process_prompt_template(
                        template=template_value,
                        name="template",
                        custom_fields=build_config["custom_fields"],
                        frontend_node_template=build_config,
                        is_mustache=is_mustache,
                    )
                except ValueError as e:
                    # If validation fails, we still updated the mode and cleaned old fields
                    # User will see error when they try to save
                    logger.debug(f"Template validation failed during mode switch: {e}")
        return build_config

    async def build_prompt(self) -> Message:
        use_double_brackets = self.use_double_brackets if hasattr(self, "use_double_brackets") else False
        template_format = "mustache" if use_double_brackets else "f-string"
        prompt = await Message.from_template_and_variables(template_format=template_format, **self._attributes)
        self.status = prompt.text
        return prompt

    def _update_template(self, frontend_node: dict):
        prompt_template = frontend_node["template"]["template"]["value"]
        use_double_brackets = frontend_node["template"].get("use_double_brackets", {}).get("value", False)
        is_mustache = use_double_brackets is True

        try:
            # Validate mustache templates for security
            if is_mustache:
                validate_mustache_template(prompt_template)

            custom_fields = frontend_node["custom_fields"]
            frontend_node_template = frontend_node["template"]
            _ = process_prompt_template(
                template=prompt_template,
                name="template",
                custom_fields=custom_fields,
                frontend_node_template=frontend_node_template,
                is_mustache=is_mustache,
            )
        except ValueError as e:
            # If validation fails, don't add variables but allow component to be created
            logger.debug(f"Template validation failed in _update_template: {e}")
        return frontend_node

    async def update_frontend_node(self, new_frontend_node: dict, current_frontend_node: dict):
        """This function is called after the code validation is done."""
        frontend_node = await super().update_frontend_node(new_frontend_node, current_frontend_node)
        template = frontend_node["template"]["template"]["value"]
        use_double_brackets = frontend_node["template"].get("use_double_brackets", {}).get("value", False)
        is_mustache = use_double_brackets is True

        try:
            # Validate mustache templates for security
            if is_mustache:
                validate_mustache_template(template)

            # Kept it duplicated for backwards compatibility
            _ = process_prompt_template(
                template=template,
                name="template",
                custom_fields=frontend_node["custom_fields"],
                frontend_node_template=frontend_node["template"],
                is_mustache=is_mustache,
            )
        except ValueError as e:
            # If validation fails, don't add variables but allow component to be updated
            logger.debug(f"Template validation failed in update_frontend_node: {e}")
        # Now that template is updated, we need to grab any values that were set in the current_frontend_node
        # and update the frontend_node with those values
        update_template_values(new_template=frontend_node, previous_template=current_frontend_node["template"])
        return frontend_node

    def _get_fallback_input(self, **kwargs):
        return DefaultPromptField(**kwargs)
